transcript: Visiting the film set for the In the Heights movie was such a cool and surreal experience. This was in July of 2019, and as a resident of Washington Heights, I think I got some vague tip off that they were filming somewhere in my area. So I kind of went wandering to find it, and stumbling upon it was like something out of a dream. As I've said before, in the Heights is probably my second favorite musical of all time, and it was like I got to step into it. Filming took place all around Washington Heights, but there was one primary intersection where the main locations were set. Usnavi's Bodega, Daniela's Salon, and Rosario's Car Service, all at opposing corners at the intersection of 175th and Audobon Avenue. Sets were built somewhat over the real building's facades, although the Bodega was and still is really a Bodega, and the storefront they used for Rosario’s was actually a car service at the time, although now it's a hardware store. By contrast, the storefront they use for the exterior of Daniela's Salon is completely fake. That's actually just a house. just down the street, there's also the Washington Heights Rec Center with a large public pool that 96,000 takes place in. And there are plenty other filming spots around the neighborhood that you can still visit. But being at that intersection when those storefronts were up, the businesses that are so central to this specific story and the beating heart of the show in a lot of ways was really something special. And for those keeping track at home, that does mean that I've been to the real life locations (ish) of both of my two favourite musicals. I posted a video a little while back about going to the real island from Sunday in the park with George as well.
